style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 2 Christmas Tree Character Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Bring a touch of cozy magic to your tree with these whimsical Decoris plush ornaments. Crafted from soft, tactile polyester, these smiling characters feature playful striped legs and shimmering tinsel accents. With their cheerful embroidered faces and glittering star toppers, they add a heartwarming, festive glow that delights both kids and adults alike.</p><ul><li>Dimensions approximately 21 cm length, 11 cm width, 4 cm height<br></li><li>Green and cream coloured designs with smiling embroidered faces<br></li><li>Decorated with tinsel fibers and a glittering star on top<br></li><li>Comes with a golden hanging cord for easy placement on branches</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This playful Decoris ornament is designed for hanging in the Christmas tree and brings a cheerful character theme to seasonal decorating. Made from soft polyester, it adds a cozy, plush accent among baubles and lights. The visual on the Christmas tree is lively and fun, thanks to the smiling tree shape, striped legs, and sparkling details. Assorted color variations create a light-hearted mix that suits both classic and modern festive styles. A golden hanger and glittering star topper complete the look with a subtle shine. Made of soft polyester for a plush tree-shaped ornament. Dimensions approximately 21 cm length, 11 cm width, 4 cm height. Assorted color designs with smiling embroidered faces. Decorated with tinsel fibers and a glittering star on top. Equipped with a golden hanging cord for easy placement on branches.
